checks.detail: ['F1', 'F2a', 'F2b']: the only structurally declared ambient object is X^{s,delta}_vac(AF); the smooth-with-decay branch has no ambient set, only a Frechet topology named. (A prose-proximity probe false-positives on F2b; replaced by the structural probe, regression-pinned by K6.)

F1.declared_ambient_space: the constraint manifold X^{s,delta}_vac(AF) of one-ended asymptotically flat VACUUM initial data in the declared regularity class, carrying the topology induced from the weighted Sobolev product H^s_delta x H^{s-1}_{delta+1}. R1 F04 accepted: the topology is the SUBSPACE topology on the constraint set, not the topology of the unconstrained product (under the latter reading X_vac itself is meager and no G exists). X_vac is a closed subset of a Banach space, hence a Baire space, so comeagerness is non-vacuous and G is non-empty.
